1. RFC 8259: Yes. 42 alone is a valid JSON text because a JSON value may be a number; an object or array is not required. Object member names SHOULD be unique, not MUST be unique. This distinction means uniqueness is recommended, not an absolute requirement. RFC 8259, Sections 2–4.

2. Apollo 11 dates (NASA):

Launch: July 16, 1969.

Lunar landing: July 20, 1969.

Splashdown: July 24, 1969.

These are three distinct mission events; July 20 is the lunar touchdown date, not merely the date of the first moonwalk. NASA — Apollo Missions.

3. Python 3.14: Dictionary insertion order has been guaranteed since Python 3.7. Python 3.6 preserved insertion order in CPython, but it was not yet a language guarantee. Updating an existing key does not change its position. Python 3.14 — Built-in Types, Dictionary documentation.
